note_tweet.text:
I used to have career goals, but after being tormented by mental illness several times they are all gone. Research, GPA, and all that no longer matter. All I want is go wherever my boyfriend goes in the future, find a random job like a waiter to earn some money and survive, or I could just stay home every day and cook for my boyfriend when he comes back from work.
Because I really don’t want career-related pressure to trigger my mental illness again. Right now, I only want two things: 1. For my mental illness not to relapse. 2. To stay with my boyfriend.
